description: This file handles deletion of a PurchaseOrder record within the vtiger CRM system. It verifies the request, performs the delete operation via DeleteEntity, and redirects to a specified URL.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: A base class for CRM entities providing an instance method to retrieve the entity object based on the current module.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of the CRMEntity associated with the current module.
